name: Cordless Handheld Vacuum Cleaner
description: A lightweight, cordless handheld vacuum offers strong suction for quick clean‑ups on carpets, hardwood, and upholstery. The rechargeable lithium‑ion battery provides up to 35 minutes of runtime, and the detachable motorhead switches between crevice and brush modes.
shortDescription: Cordless handheld vacuum with strong suction and multiple attachments.

reviews.title: Powerful Suction in a Compact Design
reviews.comment: The cordless handheld vacuum delivers strong suction for a handheld size, and the battery lasts long enough for quick clean‑ups around the house. I especially appreciate the lightweight feel and the handy crevice tool that reaches tight spots, though the dust cup could be a bit larger.
